title: Check if your building permit needs plans

paragraphs: Most building permit applications require architectural plans.
We review every building permit application for life safety and building code compliance.

sections.heading: “No plans” projects
paragraphs: These projects do not require plans:
Replace windows in-kind (same size and location): must be applied for through the PermitSF portal
Replace doors in-kind (same size and location): must be applied for through the PermitSF portal
Replace or repair exterior siding in-kind (same size and location): must be applied for through the PermitSF portal
Non-structural re-roofing : must be applied for through the PermitSF portal
In-kind, non-structural kitchen or bathroom work in an occupancy class R-3 residential building or an R-2 apartment building constructed before 1991: must be applied for through the PermitSF portal
Repair less than 50% of a deck and exterior stairs and without adding any new firewalls : apply over-the-counter .
Minor dry rot repairs : apply over-the-counter .
See San Francisco Building Code Section 106 A.2
All other projects require architectural plans. Follow our instructions to create PDFs of your plans .
